nodes.label: Games
details: New Games mode on its own rail item (Alt+3) with a home page and game pages (Overview, Videos, Guides, Search).
Detects Minecraft Bedrock, Minecraft Java and any game you add from Steam or the Microsoft Store.
In-game overlay (Mod+Alt+O) with free-position widgets, and a pinned glance (Mod+Alt+P).
Ghost mode for the mini player while a game runs, with a full-screen layout editor.
Automatic tags for videos downloaded from a game's Search or Videos tab.

nodes.label: Settings
details: Dynamic Island over other apps (Always, When active, Off) in Settings > Appearance.
Settings > Updates has a Download tools row.

nodes.label: Playlists
details: New playlist page with a full-width header, cover, creator avatars and total length.
Resume where you left off, or Start over.
Sortable table by views, uploaded, added and duration, with channel names that open the creator page.
Drag rows to reorder any playlist, downloaded ones included, saved on disk.
Drop a row on the cover to start from that video.
Rename a playlist and give it a description.
Suggested shelf under every playlist with YouTube videos you don't have yet, and Find more search in the shelf.
Recommended playlists, a New badge and a Recently played sort.
Watched and missing rows, Relocate for missing files, and bulk watched actions.
Undo after removing a video.
Drop a YouTube link on a playlist card to download into it.
Choose what happens at the end of a playlist.

nodes.label: Playback
details: Play next and Add to queue for videos, Shift+N and Shift+P to skip inside a playlist.
Video playlists play in their own order with auto-advance and loop inside the playlist.

nodes.label: Downloads
details: Faster playlist download screen with per-row cancel, search, a live size total and a Downloads icon stack.
Resume paused downloads from the bell.
The download queue survives a restart.
Ffmpeg and yt-dlp download on first launch after you confirm, with a progress ring on the sidebar download icon.

nodes.label: Notifications
details: From the dev announcements and polls in the bell, with voting, live results and a mute toggle.

nodes.label: Updates
details: An update button at the bottom of the sidebar and in the Music storage bar installs and restarts.

nodes.label: Playlists
details: Each YouTube list keeps its own folder.
Videos past number 100 are numbered correctly.
Failed videos explain what went wrong in plain words.
Deleting a playlist asks first.

nodes.label: Music
details: The now-playing bar shows the playing song's cover instead of its playlist's cover.

nodes.label: Installer
details: Much smaller download.

nodes.label: Settings
details: Notifications in island moved from Debugging to Appearance, still off by default.

nodes.label: Updates
details: The update card no longer appears in the Dynamic Island.
